title: Bills trade up to take CB Davison Igbinosun, Broncos still haven't made a pick

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bills trade up to take CB Davison Igbinosun, Broncos still haven't made a pick
sources.description: The Broncos were set to make their first pick of the 2026 draft at No. 62, but the wait will go on a little longer.
